notes: Key ask: production-grade Dedicated with predictable throughput for trading desk chat assistant
Throughput target: steady-state 2,500 tokens/sec (equiv ~400 short requests/sec) across peak 9-11am ET window
Latency SLOs: P95 <= 120ms for <512 token requests; P99 <= 300ms. Current POC P95=160ms -> need tuning
Reserved planning: customer prefers commit for 8 x A100-class GPUs (estimate) + 2 hot spare nodes for maintenance
Autoscaling policy desires: horizontal scale-up when GPU util > 65% AND queue_latency > 40ms for 3 consecutive 10s windows; scale-down only after 10m cool-down and single-step to avoid flapping
Warm pools: pre-warm 20% of reserved capacity as 'hot warm' (kernels + KV cache primed) to reduce cold-start tails; pre-warm time budget ~45s per node
Queueing behavior: want bounded queue depth per model route (max 200 inflight tokens) and request backpressure to client with retry guidance
Fallback strategy: automatic routing to quantized 13B variant (q4) for tail latency breaches and to hosted burst when Dedicated is saturated
Kernel preload: explicit ask to support per-model kernel bake to reduce first-request jitter; also pre-warm KV caches for conversational state
Cost sensitivity: target unit economics < $0.003/token for heavy reranking pipelines; propose Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and mixed-precision
SLA negotiation points: 99.95% uptime, 95th latency credit policy, rolling maintenance windows limited to 2 hours/month; expect SLA credits or service credit tiers for violations
Procurement note: legal pushing for 'no more than 30-day termination with pro-rata refund' on reserved capacity; finance wants quarterly invoicing
Security: require HSM/KMS integration for customer-managed keys; preserve audit logs for 12 months; data residency in us-east-1 mandatory
Quote from CTO: 'We need guarantees on tail latency more than raw peak throughput — jitter kills UX.'
Next technical deep-dive: sizing model memory footprint and tokenization patterns for our trade chat dataset (Ethan to drive)

Observed failure mode: scale-up ramp caused GPU contention for memory when multiple large prompts arrive simultaneously — suggested solution: queue-aware admission + prefer smaller batch sizes under memory pressure
Open action: provide detailed reserved sizing workbook (expected v2) and cost simulation for steady + burst scenarios
